tokens.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_skywrath_mage_arcan: Skywrath Mage launches a slow-moving bolt of arcane magic, dealing damage to an enemy unit based on Skywrath Mage's intelligence.
Within the Ghastly Eyrie's endless intrigue, only the clever and calm can hope to survive.
The projectile moves very slowly (500 ms), providing 325 vision around it.  Upon impact, it will reveal the target area for 3.34 seconds.

When Skywrath Mage casts Arcane Bolt, %total_bolt_count% bolts are created, one aimed at the original target, and two others aimed at random enemies within %extra_bolt_search_radius% range of the original target. Heroes will take priority.

tokens.npc_dota_hero_skywrath_mage_bio:
A highly placed mage in the court of the Ghastly Eyrie, Dragonus lives a troubled existence. Sworn by birth to protect whoever sits within the Nest of Thorns, he hates the current Skywrath queen with all his soul. As a youth, high-born, he was a friend and companion to the eldest Skywrath princess, Shendelzare, first in line for the Nest. He had loved her warmly and unshakably, but as his studies took hold, his mind turned to arcane learning and the mastery of Skywrath sorcery.

Obsessed with matters aetherial, he missed the mundane signs of courtly treachery that hinted at a plot against Shendelzare, and lost his chance to foil it. When the court was shaken by a swift and violent coup, he emerged from his studies to discover his oldest and dearest friend had been lost to him. The Nest of Thorns now belonged to Shendelzare's ruthless younger sister, and Dragonus could do nothing. The magic of the Skywrath Mage serves only the sworn protector of the Skywrath scion, so to act against the Nest would render him helpless. He clings to his post, believing it to be the best hope of one day restoring his true love to her rightful place. Meanwhile, his secret is known only to the goddess Scree'Auk, whose magic it was transformed Shendelzare from a crippled physical creature into an embodiment of pure vengeful energy.

While he dreams of restoring his beloved queen to the Ghastly Eyrie, he dreams even more desperately of restoring Shendelzare herself to a fully healed physical form. The duplicity of his role at court tortures him, for he is a noble and good-hearted creature; but the worst torture of all is imagining the hatred that Vengeful Spirit must hold in her heart for him.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_skywrath_mage_hype: Deadly and fragile in equal measure, Skywrath Mage quickly destroys his enemies with a barrage of powerful magic. He silences foes while increasing their vulnerability to spells, meaning he has no trouble vaporizing any who stand against him.

* Stacks multiplicatively with other {{M|magic resistance}} sources.

* Considers {{M|illusions}} and {{M|creep-heroes}} as creeps.

* {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|skywrath_mage_ancient_seal}}
** Reapplying the debuff refreshes the duration.
<hr>
* {{cf|aghnotes}}
** {{Symbol|Target|Unit}} {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Vision|Base}} {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}} {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
*** Searches and passively casts Ancient Seal on another random [[visible]] enemy unit, prioritizing heroes, within the secondary search radius upon cast on the same {{M|server tick}}.
*** Considers {{M|clones}} and {{M|illusions}} as heroes, {{M|creep-heroes}} as creeps.
*** Does not passively cast on the following units:
**** {{M|Hidden}} units.
**** {{M|Invisible}} units.
**** {{M|Invulnerable}} units.
**** {{M|Spell immune}} units.
*** [[File:Dota2 Cast Range to AoE Visualization icon-2-1.png|84px]][[File:Dota2 Cast Range to AoE Visualization icon-2-2.png|84px]]
**** The secondary search radius is centered around the primary {{Symbol|Target|Unit}} unit-targeted enemy, within radius [[File:Dota2 Letter-p.png|P|21px]] , when no other targets are available, nothing happens.
**** Can affect secondary enemy units at max {{Symbol|bonus cas}} {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} {{ValueColor||{{calc|v1+{{#var:Ancient Seal type2 value1 agh}}|v1={{#var:Ancient Seal cast range}}}}|agh}}-distance away with the [[cast range]] and secondary target search radius.
** The passive cast has the following properties:
*** Works independently of Ancient Seal's {{M|cooldown}}, and does not cost {{M|mana}}.
*** Does not proc {{M|on-cast effects}}.

* [[File:Dota2 Cast Range to AoE Visualization icon-8-1.png|84px]][[File:Dota2 Cast Range to AoE Visualization icon-8-2.png|84px]]
** Can affect enemy units at max {{Symbol|bonus cas}} {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} {{#expr:{{#var:Mystic Flare cast range}}+{{#var:Mystic Flare value1}}}}-distance away with the [[cast range]] and [[effect radius]].

* The ability effects are applied as follows:
*# {{Symbol|Damage|Magical}} {{Symbol|Spell Damage}}
*#* Has the following damage priority:
*#** {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}} Enemy heroes {{to}} {{M|Lane creeps}} and/or {{M|neutral creeps}}.
*#*** Considers {{M|clones}}, {{M|illusions}}, and {{M|creep-heroes}} as heroes.
*#*** Creeps are only damaged if there are no other enemy heroes within the radius.
*#** Does not affect the following units:
*#*** {{M|Invulnerable}} units.
*#*** {{M|Spell immune}} units.
*#* Deals {{Code|( {{calc|v1*{{#var:Mystic Flare value3}}|v1={{#var:Mystic Flare value4}}}} OR {{ValueColor||{{calc|v1*{{#var:Mystic Flare value3}}|v1={{#var:Mystic Flare value4 tal}}}}|tal|x}} ) / NumberOfHeroes}} spell damage within the radius in {{#var:Mystic Flare value3}}-second intervals, {{#var:Mystic Flare value3}} seconds upon debuff application, over {{#expr:{{#var:Mystic Flare value5}}/{{#var:Mystic Flare value3}}}} damage instances.
*# {{Symbol|Modifier|Stack}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
*#* Grants 1 {{A|Skywrath Mage|Shield of the Scion}} stack per damage instance applied.
<hr>
* {{cf|aghnotes}}
** {{Symbol|Target|AreaAlt}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Vision|Base}} {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
*** Searches and passively casts Mystic Flare on a random [[visible]] enemy unit, prioritizing heroes, within the secondary search radius upon cast on the same {{M|server tick}}.
*** Does not passively cast on the following units:
**** {{M|Invisible}} units.
**** Other unit-affecting restrictions still apply.
*** [[File:Dota2 Skywrath Mage Mystic Flare Visualized icon-1-1.png|84px]][[File:Dota2 Skywrath Mage Mystic Flare Visualized icon-1-2.png|84px]]
**** The secondary search radius is centered around the primary {{Symbol|Target|AreaAlt}} area-targeted location, within [[Wikipedia:Circle|circle]] [[File:Dota2 Letter-b.png|B|21px]] , when no other targets are available, nothing happens.
***** Hence, the secondary Mystic Flare is cast at max {{Symbol|bonus cas}} {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} {{ValueColor||{{#expr:{{#var:Mystic Flare cast range}}+{{#var:Mystic Flare type2 value1 agh}}}}|agh}}-distance away.
***** Can affect other enemy units at max {{Symbol|bonus cas}} {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} {{ValueColor||{{#expr:{{#var:Mystic Flare cast range}}+{{#var:Mystic Flare value1}}+{{#var:Mystic Flare type2 value1 agh}}}}|agh}}-distance away with the cast range, the [[effect radius]], and the secondary target search radius.

fields.value: Shield of the Scion: Absorbing x incoming magic damage.

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
* {{Symbol|Modifier|Stack}}
** Grants a stack as long as a damage instance is recorded in the {{M|combat log}} from Dragonus' abilities, this includes the following:
*** Upon Dragonus' {{M|Spell Reflection}} procs.
*** Procs from {{M|on-damage effects}}, this includes 0-damage instances or negative damage instances.
** Each stack grants a new buff on Dragonus, with each stack buff duration independent of the other.
** Does not proc on the following sources:
*** Item abilities.
*** 0-second {{M|cooldown}} sources.
*** Sources that do not proc {{M|on-cast effects}}.
*** {{M|HP Removal}} sources.

* Grants the following amount of Shield of the Scion stacks per ability cast:
** 1 stack per {{A|Skywrath Mage|Arcane Bolt}} impact.
** 1 stack per {{A|Skywrath Mage|Concussive Shot}} damage instance applied.
** 1 stack per {{A|Skywrath Mage|Mystic Flare}} damage instance applied.
** {{Symbol|bonus db-mag}}
*** The [[damage barrier]] applied is defined as:
*** {{cf|expr}} {{Code|Barrier {{=}} ( {{#var:Shield of the Scion value2}} + {{#var:Shield of the Scion basic1}} × HeroLVL) × f(Instance) )}}

data.name: npc_dota_hero_skywrath_mage
data.bio_loc:
A highly placed mage in the court of the Ghastly Eyrie, Dragonus lives a troubled existence. Sworn by birth to protect whoever sits within the Nest of Thorns, he hates the current Skywrath queen with all his soul. As a youth, high-born, he was a friend and companion to the eldest Skywrath princess, Shendelzare, first in line for the Nest. He had loved her warmly and unshakably, but as his studies took hold, his mind turned to arcane learning and the mastery of Skywrath sorcery.

Obsessed with matters aetherial, he missed the mundane signs of courtly treachery that hinted at a plot against Shendelzare, and lost his chance to foil it. When the court was shaken by a swift and violent coup, he emerged from his studies to discover his oldest and dearest friend had been lost to him. The Nest of Thorns now belonged to Shendelzare's ruthless younger sister, and Dragonus could do nothing. The magic of the Skywrath Mage serves only the sworn protector of the Skywrath scion, so to act against the Nest would render him helpless. He clings to his post, believing it to be the best hope of one day restoring his true love to her rightful place. Meanwhile, his secret is known only to the goddess Scree'Auk, whose magic it was transformed Shendelzare from a crippled physical creature into an embodiment of pure vengeful energy.

While he dreams of restoring his beloved queen to the Ghastly Eyrie, he dreams even more desperately of restoring Shendelzare herself to a fully healed physical form. The duplicity of his role at court tortures him, for he is a noble and good-hearted creature; but the worst torture of all is imagining the hatred that Vengeful Spirit must hold in her heart for him.
data.hype_loc: Deadly and fragile in equal measure, Skywrath Mage quickly destroys his enemies with a barrage of powerful magic. He silences foes while increasing their vulnerability to spells, meaning he has no trouble vaporizing any who stand against him.
data.npe_desc_loc: Casts high damage magical spells on a single target

abilities.name: skywrath_mage_arcane_bolt
abilities.desc_loc: Skywrath Mage launches a slow-moving bolt of arcane magic, dealing damage to an enemy unit based on Skywrath Mage's intelligence.
abilities.lore_loc: Within the Ghastly Eyrie's endless intrigue, only the clever and calm can hope to survive.
notes_loc: The projectile moves very slowly (500 ms), providing 325 vision around it.  Upon impact, it will reveal the target area for 3.34 seconds.
abilities.shard_loc: When Skywrath Mage casts Arcane Bolt, %total_bolt_count% bolts are created, one aimed at the original target, and two others aimed at random enemies within %extra_bolt_search_radius% range of the original target. Heroes will take priority.

abilities.name: skywrath_mage_concussive_shot
abilities.desc_loc: Skywrath Mage sets off a long range shot that hits the closest hero within a long range.  Upon impact, it deals damage and slows in an area of effect.
abilities.lore_loc: Those who serve the court of the Ghastly Eyrie are ever locked in covert war. One must always know where danger lurks nearest.
notes_loc: If no enemy heroes are in range or they are in fog, Concussive Shot targets the nearest enemy creep.
Damages creeps around the impact area.
Provides 400 vision around the projectile, and reveals the target area for 3.34 seconds upon impact.
abilities.scepter_loc: When Skywrath Mage casts Concussive Shot, a different random target within %scepter_radius% range of the original target will be hit with the same ability. Heroes will take priority.

abilities.name: skywrath_mage_ancient_seal
abilities.desc_loc: Skywrath Mage seals the targeted unit with an ancient rune, silencing it and causing it to take additional damage from spells.
abilities.lore_loc: A holy incantation, whosoever finds themselves touched by Avilliva's sigil must suffer in penitent silence.
notes_loc: The magic damage resistance reduction doesn't affect creeps.
abilities.scepter_loc: Anytime Skywrath Mage casts Ancient Seal, a different random target within %scepter_radius% range of the original target will be affected by the same ability. Heroes will take priority.

abilities.name: skywrath_mage_shield_of_the_scion
abilities.desc_loc: Every time Skywrath Mage deals magical damage to an enemy hero with his abilities, he gains a small magic damage barrier. Each buff stacks independently.
abilities.lore_loc: The court mages of Skywrath may only deploy their magic in defense of the kingdom and the throne.

abilities.name: skywrath_mage_mystic_flare
abilities.desc_loc: Skywrath Mage uses his ultimate magical ability to conjure a precise and violent mystical field that lays waste to his adversaries. Deals massive damage distributed evenly among any Heroes in the area over %duration% seconds.
abilities.lore_loc: Only the most practiced of Skywrath sorcerers could hope to shape the skies into such a storm.
notes_loc: Mystic Flare only affects Heroes. Mystic Flare does not damage creep heroes.
Mystic Flare will damage enemy creeps if no enemy heroes are present.
Mystic Flare will immediately destroy illusions.
abilities.scepter_loc: When Skywrath Mage casts Mystic Flare, another Mystic Flare will be created on the position of a different random target enemy within %scepter_radius% range of the original target. Heroes will take priority.
